original_evidence.text: | Rambox (community-edition) | ramboxapp/community-edition | Electron (`electron-updater`) | Y | manual (no automatic startup or interval check found; `checkForUpdates` is wired only to a "Migrate now" button on a deprecation banner telling users this CE build is unsupported and pushing them to the paid/hosted Rambox) | Y (once triggered) | https (GitHub Releases via `electron-updater`; feed hardcoded in code to `ramboxapp/download`, while `package.json`'s `build.publish` points at `ramboxapp/community-edition` — a mismatch between build-time publish config and the runtime-overridden feed) | manifest present (`latest.yml`/`latest-mac.yml` on GitHub Releases, TLS only, not independently signed) | hash-from-manifest (default electron-updater sha512 check); Windows Authenticode verification NOT disabled (no `verifyUpdateCodeSignature: false` present, unlike Caprine/Station, so default `true` applies on the NSIS target) | OS-trust-store (Windows Authenticode publisher check, default electron-updater behavior since not overridden) | `electron/updater.js:1-27` (`autoUpdater.setFeedURL({provider:'github', owner:'ramboxapp', repo:'download', vPrefixedTagName:true})`; `ipcMain.on('autoUpdater:quit-and-install', ...) => autoUpdater.quitAndInstall(true,true)`); `app/view/main/Main.js:265-274` ("Migrate now" button → `Rambox.app.checkUpdate()`, the only call site found); `app/Application.js:249-251` (`checkUpdate` just forwards `autoUpdater:check-for-updates` over IPC); `package.json` build config `"publish":[{"provider":"github","owner":"ramboxapp","repo":"community-edition","vPrefixedTagName":false}]` (no `win.verifyUpdateCodeSignature` override present) |
